Recovered Setext
================

## Genuine Child

Prose that opens a paragraph.
Not A Heading
=============

***
Below A Thematic Break
======================

An indented code block is block-level, so `Recovered Setext` starts a fresh paragraph
and its underline promotes it — quarto renders it as a real heading. `Not A Heading`
is the second line of an open paragraph, and pandoc's `markdown` does not promote a
multi-line paragraph, so its underline is literal text.
